lines.t: My children, do you love me?
Then do as I command you, grow wise in me
And live according to my word
Even according to all these letters I have given you
By which I have said all these crooked past straight
For my every word is scripture, my every letter truth
Be cognizant of my comings and goings
For I have indeed come to live in those who have received of me
Those who obey my voice and embrace me as I truly am
Again I say to you, honor me first with your ways
Then with your mouth
For honor only spoken of is but wind
The veil of the hypocrite
Who knows not where he is going
Having no remorse over where he has been
For how can one who professes to love me
Live contrary to me
Contrary to me
Beloved ones, I love you as I love the Father
In the same way, whoever loves me loves the Father also
I obey the Father in all things
Because I love the Father and the Father is in me
Likewise those who were truly my disciples
Obey my voice cause they love me and I live in them
Thank you.
